description: fz-go4.18.12 finding 4. Each callee return-type revision triggers a FULL re-inference of every caller body: AnalyzeActivation(main) fired 22x on 00001 (12 distinct analyses, 10 no-change); callsite.defined 133 fires / 26 keys with 76 byte-identical re-publications; return_type.defined 45 fires / only 8 changed on 00181. FIX direction (design work): batch callee revisions before re-analyzing a caller, and/or granularize analysis so only the affected callsite's contribution is recomputed; at minimum suppress identical re-publications (interacts with T1's stop-at-unchanged). Re-measure after findings 1-3 land — the counts may drop substantially. ACCEPTANCE: identical callsite/return_type re-publications ~0 on the corpus; AnalyzeActivation fire counts justified by distinct input revisions.

comments.text: Re-scoped context: much of the re-analysis churn is downstream of the .18.22 oscillation/wipes. Re-measure the AnalyzeActivation/callsite re-publication counts after .18.22 lands; implement only what remains.

title: Per-callee-revision whole-caller re-analysis: batch/granularize activation re-inference
